steps: Cook brown rice in 400 ml of water in a medium saucepan for 18 to 20 minutes, until tender.
Pit and peel 4 plums; slice them thinly and set aside.
Cook the plum slices in a small non-stick pan over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until very soft.
Halve and pit 2 avocados; scoop the flesh into a medium bowl.
Add the lemon juice and ground ginger to the avocado; mash with a fork until smooth.
Fluff the cooked brown rice and divide it evenly among 4 small cups or bowls.
Spoon the mashed avocado over the rice in each cup, then top with the soft plum slices.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 day; do not freeze.
